name: Health Systems & Policy
description: Health policy analysis, implementation science, epidemiology, health services delivery, vaccination uptake, chronic disease management, healthcare delivery transformation, pandemic preparedness, and quality improvement. APR brings mixed-methods, stakeholder-centered design, and computational modeling to health policy.

included: Health services delivery research and optimization
Digital health and health information technology
excluded: Pure bench science / wet lab research
Pure clinical trials without health services framing
Animal studies without human population relevance

primary_filter.name: Policy Translation
primary_filter.optimal: Research with direct policy or practice implications
primary_filter.minimum: Clear pathway from findings to actionable recommendations
primary_filter.exclude_below: Basic science without stated policy relevance

funding_preference.deprioritized: >$2M unless APR has strong PI partnership

eligibility_filter.flag: Grants requiring 501(c)(3) — APR needs fiscal sponsor or academic partner
eligibility_filter.prioritize: Grants open to for-profit research organizations or with subcontractor path
eligibility_filter.note: Most NIH grants require academic PI — APR as co-I or subcontractor
